name: chrysalis-root
description: Chrysalis — a web framework you can grow inside a legacy PHP app until it consumes it.

scripts.migration-debt:gate:ingest: node scripts/migration-debt.mjs --project fixtures/tiny-blog --max-holes 0 && node scripts/migration-debt.mjs --project fixtures/mysqli-probe --max-holes 0 && node scripts/migration-debt.mjs --project fixtures/db-query-unknown-receiver-probe --max-holes 1 && node scripts/migration-debt.mjs --project fixtures/laravel-shaped-db-factory-probe --max-holes 0 && node scripts/migration-debt.mjs --project fixtures/parser-parity-probe --max-holes 0
scripts.ci:emit-check: node scripts/run-e2e.mjs && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix generated/tiny-blog && npx tsc --noEmit -p generated/tiny-blog/tsconfig.json && node scripts/emit-tiny-blog-fastify.mjs && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --prefix generated/tiny-blog-fastify && npx tsc --noEmit -p generated/tiny-blog-fastify/tsconfig.json
scripts.ci:insight: node packages/cli/dist/bin.js insight fixtures/tiny-n1 --out reports/insight/tiny-n1.json --json && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs tiny-n1-insight
scripts.verify:laravel-full:5nines: node scripts/verify-flagship-laravel-full.mjs --seed-variants=baseline,empty,ten --stress-runs=3 && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs confidence-5nines && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs confidence-trend
scripts.build:hub-all: pnpm -r build && pnpm run vendor:parser-bridge && pnpm run vendor:oracle-java && pnpm run hub:install-wptp
scripts.test:hub-oracle-smoke: node scripts/hub-ingest/hub-oracle-record.mjs --origin python --out reports/ci/hub-oracle-python-smoke.ndjson && node scripts/hub-ingest/hub-oracle-record.mjs --origin javascript --out reports/ci/hub-oracle-node-smoke.ndjson
scripts.ci:hub-knowledge: pnpm run hub:path-knowledge && pnpm run hub:web-databases && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs hub-path-knowledge reports/ci/hub-path-knowledge.json && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs hub-web-databases reports/ci/hub-web-databases.json
scripts.ci:hub-completion: node scripts/hub-ingest/hub-completion.mjs --json-out reports/ci/hub-completion.json && node scripts/ci-gates.mjs hub-completion reports/ci/hub-completion.json && pnpm run ci:hub-knowledge
scripts.deploy:agenticop-site: pnpm run sync:agenticop-site && firebase deploy --only hosting
